about: Marking sheet for RETRIEVAL RECALL on the held-out questions. The rules below define the measurement; retrieval_recall.py only applies them. For each fact, all_of is a list of groups: every group must match, and a group matches if ANY of its wordings is present. LOCK RULE: write a case before its search results are opened, and never change it after its results are seen; make a new version instead. Each result file records a fingerprint of the rules and of each case, so any later change is visible.
metric_question: Did search bring back the facts the right answer needs?
look_in_means: the pieces search handed to the helpers, saved in the run record (details.pieces)

rules.found_means: the fact is inside at least one piece search handed to the helpers
rules.score: facts found / facts that exist in the documents
